newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares revive, Moeller shipping in focus.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares revive, Moeller shipping in focus.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Thursday, reviving after recent off days on interest in Moeller shipping and tele-operator Tele Danmark stock, with dealers seeing Friday's trend depending on Moeller's ongoing performance.
"Buy recommendations pushed Moeller up, which again helped the index higher. Shipping paper is generally doing well, tomorrow hinges on Moeller developments" one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index gained 1.65 point to finish at 186.41 in overall bourse turnover of 1.083 billion crowns. The KFX August future rose 2.20 point to 187.25 in 357 contract trade.
Moeller's D/S 1912 and D/S Svendborg closed 15,000 and 16,000 higher at 305,000 and 435,000 crowns respectively.
Tele Danmark finished five crowns up at 399.
Also in focus was insurer Codan, which shed 50 crowns to end the day at 980 after issuing interim results which disappointed a market expecting bigger first-half 1997 profits.
